title: Squirrels, Macaws, and Creatures of the Night
excerpt: I spent a full day at Singapore Zoo and Night Safari — and accidentally stepped on a squirrel, sending me into a guilt spiral that only the kindness of strangers could fix.

photos.alt: Visitors queuing at the entrance of Singapore Zoo beneath a large red logo sign with a leaping orangutan mascot
Interior of a Singapore MRT car with teal seats, a display reading 'Next Station Newton', and a passenger reading on his phone
A blue-and-yellow macaw and a scarlet macaw perched side by side on a wooden railing against lush tropical greenery
A large orangutan resting face-down on bamboo poles inside a rainforest enclosure, its long reddish fur covering most of its body
Two pig-like babirusas walking across a yellow-lit rocky stage inside the Night Safari after-dark enclosure
